summary: Sync uses the configured AAP token; identity data and token-visible job templates sync. Prerequisites: AAP admin credentials, completed org sync, Execute permission on job templates for users, and 'Allow external users to create OAuth2 tokens' enabled. Create a role in Administration > RBAC (e.g. portal-users) and assign AAP teams and users.
questions: How do I create a role in self-service automation portal?
Where is RBAC in the portal?
